easy.def: Not being nice to look at.
examples: The ugliness of the old shed was plain.
There was ugliness in the trash.

more.def: The quality of being unpleasant to look at.
examples: The ugliness of the old shed was hidden by flowers.
The ugliness of the broken wall was covered with paint.
Rain washed away the ugliness of the muddy yard.
The old, ugly couch was thrown away.
She wore an ugly green sweater to the party.
The ugly weeds covered the garden.
